sentence_1_it: Ho incontrato tua madre su Facebook. Perciò se non ci fosse Facebook non ci saresti neanche tu, angioletto.
sentence_1_en: I met your mother through Facebook. So, if Facebook didn't exist, neither would you, my little angel.
